name: Dify Search API
description: Search API backend that indexes Drupal content into a Dify knowledge base, with automatic/parent-child/contextual-field chunking and optional Dify-Workflow file text extraction.
project_description: Dify Search API is a submodule of the Dify project. It registers a Search API backend plugin (id 'dify') that pushes indexed Drupal content into a Dify knowledge base (dataset) instead of a local search index. Per-field priorities (entered on the Search API index fields form in place of the boost column) drive how each field is placed into the Dify document: high-priority fields form a parent/identity block, lower-priority fields become child paragraphs, and priority 0 excludes a field. Three chunking modes are offered (automatic, parent-child hierarchical, and a Drupal-side 'contextual field' strategy that maps one segment per field and tracks them in a dify_field_segment_map table for differential sync). A custom 'Dify File Extraction' Search API data type sends file/image fields to a Dify Workflow (OCR/parsing) and indexes the returned text. Credentials (base URL, dataset API key, dataset ID, and an optional file-extraction Workflow API key) are entered on the Search API server backend form and stored in Drupal State keyed by server id, never exported with configuration. Requires the dify base module and drupal/search_api ^1.40, plus league/html-to-markdown for HTML-to-Markdown field conversion.
